english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a person, army, town, or fortification submitting to an enemy or authority.
Use this when someone gives in to an enemy or opposing force rather than continuing to resist.

examples.english: The soldiers chose to surrender when the enemy surrounded them.
examples.traditional: 班士兵見到敵軍包圍，就即刻投降。
examples.jyutping: baan1 si6 bing1 gin3 dou2 dik6 gwan1 baau1 wai4 zau6 zik1 hak1 tau4 hong4

examples.english: The enemy surrounded the whole city, and the defenders finally had to yield.
examples.traditional: 敵軍包圍咗成個城，守軍最後唯有投降。
examples.jyutping: dik6 gwan1 baau1 wai4 zo2 seng4 go3 sing4 sau2 gwan1 zeoi3 hau6 wai4 jau5 tau4 hong4
